validation_criteria: Blocking behavior is observed during the workload.
Blocked requests show `LCK_M_S` wait type in `sys.dm_exec_requests`.
Blocking session IDs do not correspond to active queries in `sys.dm_exec_requests`.
symptom_evidence: Blocked insert operations with `LCK_M_S` wait type.
Blocking session IDs that are not active queries.
mechanism_evidence: Excessive number of indexes causing contention during insert operations.
Uncommitted transactions holding locks and causing blocking.
